title: Non-noble metal–organic frameworks in electrocatalytic urea-assisted hydrogen production and energy-saving regeneration
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02029H, Review Article
Soheila Sanati, Rajender S. Varma, Min Liu, Reza Abazari
The current review presents the importance of non-noble MOFs for H2 production in urea-assisted water electrolyzers, through which the UOR becomes the favored anodic half-reaction during water electrolysis to enhance the overall system efficiency.
